snippet.title: Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective -Announcement Trailer - Nintendo Switch
snippet.description:
Based on the children’s book series, make your way through massive, strikingly detailed mazes in Labyrinth City: Pierre the Maze Detective. Coming to Nintendo Switch this spring!

Learn more:  https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/labyrinth-city-pierre-the-maze-detective-switch
